items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the autobiographical account 'Deep Water', and answer.

"For three months Kavi went to the pool every evening and stood at the shallow end with a coach who never hurried him. First he only put his face in the water. Then he learnt to breathe out under it, then to kick while holding the rail. On the day he finally let go and swam a width alone, he did not cheer. He simply turned round and swam back, to make sure it was true."

What did Kavi do first?
items.answer: He only put his face in the water.
items.markingKey: He only put his face in the water. (1–2 marks for a complete answer.)
